description: Connect asset, software and vulnerability information in a shared knowledge layer. OMNIRES brings security data into context so your team can explore relationships and ask better questions about its environment.
fabricTitle: A shared language for your security context.
fabricDescription: OMNIRES Fabric gives security data a shared meaning. Ontologies describe assets, software, observations and their relationships, making connected information easier to query and understand.

architecture.title: Connect asset and software information
architecture.text: Bring asset records, software components and vulnerability information together. Dependency-Track integration adds SBOM and component context to your security picture.

architecture.title: Make relationships explicit
architecture.text: Use a shared knowledge model to connect observations with the assets and software they describe. Preserve context across information that would otherwise sit in separate systems.

architecture.title: Ask questions across your data
architecture.text: Query connected facts and policies to investigate your environment. Give analysts a structured foundation for exploring security questions.

architecture.title: Build around your use case
architecture.text: Work with our specialists to identify relevant sources, define a focused knowledge model and connect the information your team needs.

faq.question: How can we explore OMNIRES?
faq.answer: OMNIRES is in development. Request an online presentation to explore the approach and discuss your use case with our team. We can then agree a focused evaluation or a related knowledge-engineering engagement.

faq.question: How does OMNIRES work with our existing data?
faq.answer: We start with your sources and the questions your team needs to answer. Asset and software information, including Dependency-Track data, can form the starting point for a shared knowledge model.

faq.question: Can we start with one use case?
faq.answer: Yes. A focused question helps define the relevant data, mappings and expected result. We agree the work around your systems and priorities before starting.

faq.question: Can Cyentific help build our knowledge model?
faq.answer: Our knowledge-engineering services cover ontologies, source mappings, data onboarding and queries. We help connect security information with the context your team needs to use it.
